name: agent.spawn
description: Launch a sub-agent to handle a complex, multi-step task autonomously. The sub-agent gets its own conversation and tool set, runs independently, and returns a single result. Use this for research, code search, multi-file analysis, or any task that requires several tool calls to complete. Several calls in the SAME reply run concurrently — one visible sub-agent each. Parallelize only independent, bounded work. Specify file ownership and shared resource constraints; prefer isolated workspaces for concurrent edits. Assign one integration owner for shared files and contracts, review interrupted workers’ changes, and validate the integrated result against a stable snapshot. Separate conversations do not guarantee workspace or build isolation.

prompt.description: The task prompt — what should the sub-agent accomplish?

description.description: Short user-visible description of the sub-agent's mission (shown in UI).

details.description: Optional detailed instructions, context, or constraints for the sub-agent.

allowedTools.description: Comma-separated tool names the sub-agent may use. Defaults to a safe read-only subset if omitted. Example: 'file.read,file.list,terminal.run,web.search'
